status: Decoder primitive implemented and tested; page reader/planner integration remains required
change: readAlpValues preflights the complete ALP section before output allocation, then decodes directly into one Float32Array/Float64Array backing. No vector-sized integer or exception arrays. Output and its bit view are admitted together. Decimal constants use literals and two separate multiplications; FLOAT stages round to binary32. Exception payloads are copied through integer bit views to preserve NaN payloads. Reader offset advances only after successful decoding.

validation.fixtureChecks: 30 ALP column chunks across all five row groups compared bit-for-bit with independent in-file PLAIN values. Includes vector sizes 32/1024/4096, nulls, partial vectors, zero-bit vectors, 64-bit deltas, infinities, negative zero, subnormals and three distinct NaN payloads.
validation.memory: Every fixture chunk succeeds at output bytes + 256 view charge and rejects one byte below with zero retained usage.
validation.malformed: Invalid modes, vector logs, counts, offsets, exponents, factors, exception counts/positions, bit widths, packed extents, every truncated prefix and trailing bytes reject before output allocation.

remaining: Integrate ALP enum/page dispatch into public and owned readers, including V1/V2 and planner allocation forecasts.
Validate full reader conformance and remote range fixtures after integration; all six recorded conformance failures are still open.
Decoder performs BigInt scalar arithmetic; VM scratch is not an explicit heap cap. Optimize only with fixture bit-parity and measured evidence.
Offset preflight has O(number of vectors + exceptions) work; decoding is linear in values and packed bytes.
